Pax rubs his eye with a flipper, blinking sleepily as he lies on the pillow
Pax yawns with his beak wide open and his eyes squinting
Pax keeps yawning and raises a flipper up behind his head
Pax opens both eyes wide and holds a flipper up beside his head
Pax swings a flipper out to the side and rolls over toward the phone
